search_vector_store: search a vector store by vector store id with a query payload via POST /v1/vector_stores/{vector_store_id}/search
create_vector_store: create a vector store via POST /v1/vector_stores, optionally with target_model_names for multi-model support
retrieve_vector_store: retrieve a vector store by vector store id via GET /v1/vector_stores/{vector_store_id}
list_vector_stores: list vector stores via GET /v1/vector_stores with pagination params after, before, limit, and order
create_index: create a managed vector store index via POST /v1/indexes with index_name, vector_store_index, and vector_store_name
